prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: realistic environmental GRIME DECAL ATLAS for an abandoned zombie survival game.
Generate a 4K landscape image, 3840 x 2160 pixels if supported. TRUE transparent RGBA background, semitransparent fine dust and feathered natural edges. EXACTLY 8 separate decals arranged in a strict 4 column by 2 row grid. Each decal must fit within the CENTRAL 65% of its own grid cell with at least 15% completely empty transparent padding on EVERY side. No decal or speck may enter a neighbouring cell, touch the canvas edges or be cut off. Generous clean gutters, no overlap. This is an asset sheet, no labels, no visible grid or borders.
Style: highly realistic photographic material texture with crisp irregular microdetail and organic imperfect shapes, muted dirty tones for abandoned horror environments. Perfectly orthographic front-facing flat marks, light baked as little as possible, no cast shadows, no perspective, no relief objects. Stains only; NO substrate, no concrete rectangle, no wall, no floor, no actual hands, no actual boots, no actual tire, no scene. Each decal is a fully isolated transferable stain, with irregular alpha silhouette and transparent holes where appropriate. No text, watermark, painted checkerboard, blood, gore or people.
Eight distinct earth and dirt decals in reading order: 1 irregular fine brown dirt patch with granular fading edges, 2 wet dark earthy mud splatter with small satellite droplets, 3 muddy five-finger palm impression as a dirty transfer print only, 4 one muddy boot tread PRINT with believable block sole pattern, 5 short isolated muddy tire tread PRINT segment, 6 dried brown mud stain with small cracks and broken edges, 7 broad beige dust wipe showing parallel dragged streaks, 8 sparse trail of small brown mud drops. Natural earth colors, photorealistic.
